data.body:
[operator-attested] CLOSEOUT COMPLETED BY A LATER SESSION.

Provenance: the session that authored and pushed change 1677 died after the change MERGED but
before it closed this ticket, leaving it in_progress with an EMPTY claimed_session (the
assignee joeoakhart@navapbc.com survived, so the ticket looked held but no session held it).
This session performed the closeout only — it did NOT author the change. No code was modified;
every command below was run read-only against the already-merged tree.

GERRIT: change 1677 ("ci: skip apt-get when jq is pre-installed"),
https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1677 — status MERGED.
  LLM-Review -> +1 by "rebar review bot"
  Verified   -> +1 by "Joe Oakhart"
Noted for the record rather than glossed: the Verified +1 was cast by the human/admin account,
not by "rebar CI bot" as on a typical change. The vote satisfies the gate either way, but it
means the label is an operator attestation rather than an observed bot CI run, so the local
re-runs below are the substantive evidence that the merged tree is green.

VERIFICATION AGAINST THE MERGED TREE. Worktree /Users/joeoakhart/macaw-prawn realigned to the
gerrit remote (git fetch gerrit; checkout gerrit/main = abf3817187). The landed commit
3ada40862d is an ancestor of HEAD (confirmed with git merge-base --is-ancestor).

AC1 — conditional fallback in the golden-path job. The shipped diff is a one-line change to
.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml:
    -  run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq && jq --version
    +  run: type jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || (sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq) && jq --version
Confirmed present at line 208, and confirmed to sit inside the `golden-path` job (parsed the
YAML job headers rather than eyeballing indentation). Matches the planned approach exactly.

AC2 — $ make lint
  All checks passed! / ruff format --check: files already formatted
  check_complexity_baseline.py --check: active=61 new=0 increased=0 stale=0
  zizmor: No findings to report. Good job! (1 suppressed)
  actionlint (all workflows)  <- the check that actually covers this YAML edit

AC3 — $ make typecheck
  mypy src/rebar scripts
  Success: no issues found in 515 source files

AC4 — $ python scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py
  Verified-gate parity: OK (vote.needs covers all 7 gating jobs).   [exit 0]

AC5 — $ python -m pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py -q
  17 passed in 1.45s
  The AC's stated count of 17 still holds on the merged tree, so the criterion is ticked as
  written rather than amended.

All five acceptance criteria verified as written; no amendment was required.
